concept: Grade A office tower leasing; floor picker.

shots.title: Hero
shots.section: Home hero, full screen behind the headline
shots.camera: Eye-level three-quarter view, 24mm tilt-shift, corrected verticals
shots.prompt: Architectural photograph of a Grade A office tower with a glass facade in DIFC, Dubai. Golden-hour sun rakes across the facade, verticals perfectly straight, landscaped foreground, clear sky with open space above for a headline. It must feel built and lived-in, not rendered. No people. Overall look: corporate architecture photography, 24mm; colour palette of glass blue, steel, white, black. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.

shots.title: Interiors
shots.camera: Interior, 24mm, eye level, one window light
shots.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four separate photographs separated by thin white gutters, all four in one consistent style and light. Interior photographs inside a Grade A office tower with a glass facade, finished in open-plan offices with glass partitions, staged and uncluttered, one soft daylight, nobody present. Top-left: the main living room with its view. Top-right: the kitchen and dining area. Bottom-left: the principal bedroom. Bottom-right: the principal bathroom. Overall look: corporate architecture photography, 24mm; colour palette of glass blue, steel, white, black. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
